sloka: उपकारेण वीरो हि प्रतिकारेण युज्यते ।अकृतज्ञो अप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्त्ववताम् मनः ॥४-२८-६४॥
transliteration: upakāreṇa vīro hi pratikāreṇa yujyate ।akṛtajño apratikṛto hanti sattvavatām manaḥ ॥4-28-64॥

translations.english: A hero should in return help whoever has helped him. An ungrateful person hurts the heart of the virtuous by not returning the assistance.'
